output.title: Spot trial expiry before it becomes a surprise
output.body:
If you run a small business, trial expiry is a simple workflow decision: when should an alert fire, and who should see it first? The useful diagnostic is whether the expiry dates already live in one place, such as a calendar, email, spreadsheet, or CRM, or whether they are scattered across vendor accounts. If the dates are already central, a light reminder may be enough. If they are scattered, you are probably looking at a small integration job, not a bigger overhaul.

The control stays human. Automation should surface the date; the owner still decides whether to renew, downgrade, or cancel. That matters because money movement and binding decisions belong with a person, not a script. AI can help you notice the deadline. It should not quietly choose the plan. That is a tidy way to buy the wrong thing.

A practical next step is to list every SaaS trial you are using and note which tool, if any, already tracks the renewal date. That inventory tells you whether the right answer is a simple reminder, a shared task, or a small workflow in your own environment.
